verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for {appName}

resetPassword.subject: Reset your {appName} password
resetPassword.text:
We received a request to reset the password of your {appName} account.

Your password reset code is: {code}

Enter this code in the app to choose a new password. The code is valid for {minutes} minutes. After the reset you will be signed out on all your devices.

If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {appName} password was changed
passwordChanged.text:
The password of your {appName} account was just changed, and you were signed out on your other devices.

If this was you, there is nothing else to do.

If this was not you, open the {appName} app now, tap "Forgot password" and choose a new password with the code we send you. This signs everyone else out of your account.

errors.guardianConsentRequired: You must be at least {age} years old to create your own account. Ask a parent or guardian to add you to the family first.
